paragraphs.en: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.
paragraphs.zh: 让每个人都能构建可靠且高效的软件。

paragraphs.en: Website | Getting started | Learn | Documentation | Contributing
paragraphs.zh: 网站 | 快速开始 | 学习 | 文档 | 参与贡献

paragraphs.en: This is the main source code repository for Rust . It contains the compiler, standard library, and documentation.
paragraphs.zh: 这是 Rust 的主要源代码仓库。 它包含编译器、标准库和文档。

sents.en: This is the main source code repository for Rust .
sents.zh: 这是 Rust 的主要源代码仓库。

sents.en: It contains the compiler, standard library, and documentation.
sents.zh: 它包含编译器、标准库和文档。

paragraphs.en: Performance: Fast and memory-efficient, suitable for critical services, embedded devices, and easily integrated with other languages.
paragraphs.zh: 性能：快速且内存高效，适用于关键服务和嵌入式设备，并易于与其他语言集成。

paragraphs.en: Reliability: Our rich type system and ownership model ensure memory and thread safety, reducing bugs at compile-time.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠性：我们丰富的类型系统和所有权模型确保了内存与线程安全，在编译期减少缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Productivity: Comprehensive documentation, a compiler committed to providing great diagnostics, and advanced tooling including package manager and build tool ( Cargo ), auto-formatter ( rustfmt ), linter ( Clippy ) and editor support ( rust-analyzer ).
paragraphs.zh: 生产力：全面的文档、致力于提供出色诊断信息的编译器，以及先进的工具链，包括包管理器和构建工具（Cargo）、自动格式化工具（rustfmt）、代码检查工具（Clippy）和编辑器支持（rust-analyzer）。

paragraphs.en: If you really want to install from source (though this is not recommended), see INSTALL.md .
paragraphs.zh: 如果你确实想从源码安装（虽然不推荐这样做），请参阅 INSTALL.md 。

paragraphs.en: See https://www.rust-lang.org/community for a list of chat platforms and forums.
paragraphs.zh: 有关聊天平台和论坛的列表，请参阅 https://www.rust-lang.org/community。

paragraphs.en: For a detailed explanation of the compiler's architecture and how to begin contributing, see the rustc-dev-guide .
paragraphs.zh: 有关编译器架构的详细说明以及如何开始参与贡献，请参阅 rustc-dev-guide。

paragraphs.en: See LICENSE-APACHE , LICENSE-MIT , and COPYRIGHT for details.
paragraphs.zh: 详情请参阅 LICENSE-APACHE、LICENSE-MIT 和 COPYRIGHT。
